meeting-deep-process v1.0.0

- Initial release of a platform-agnostic engine for deep meeting analysis and quality enhancement, structured as two layers covering five domains and 27 tasks.
- Offers in-depth role profiling (12-dimension model), group dynamics analysis, and meeting execution/knowledge asset extraction across 8 meeting types.
- Features an enhancement loop: pre-meeting highlight design, in-meeting interventions, post-meeting multi-dimensional diagnostics, and cross-meeting optimization.
- Adapts analytic focus and improvement strategies to eight distinct meeting scenarios, maximizing value from single or accumulated meetings.
- Implements robust fallback/degradation modes and privacy safeguards, ensuring consistent function with varying data availability.
- Provides modular task structure with clear execution workflows and outputs, including reports, diagnostics, role profiles, and actionable improvement suggestions.
